subject: Physiology
stem: SAMPLE ROW — not real question data. Which structure in the heart normally sets the pace of the cardiac cycle?
explanation: The sinoatrial node depolarises fastest (~60-100/min) and so captures the rhythm; the AV node and His-Purkinje system are slower escape pacemakers that take over only if the SA node fails.

subject: Pharmacology
stem: SAMPLE ROW — not real question data. A drug is described as having a narrow therapeutic index. What does this mean?
option_a: It is rapidly cleared by the kidney
option_b: The toxic and effective doses are close together
explanation: Therapeutic index is the ratio of toxic dose to effective dose. A narrow index means small changes in concentration can cross from therapeutic to toxic, which is why such drugs are monitored.

subject: Microbiology
stem: SAMPLE ROW — not real question data. Gram staining separates bacteria primarily on the basis of which cell feature?
explanation: Gram-positive organisms retain crystal violet because of a thick peptidoglycan layer; gram-negative organisms have a thin layer plus an outer membrane and are decolourised, then take up the counterstain.
